In the context of a CNS mass, findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS; confirmation requires B-cell immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with nesting and more abundant cytoplasm, and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Small-cell GBM is GFAP/OLIG2 positive with fibrillary background and EGFR amplification rather than CD20 positivity.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has more eccentric nuclei and plasmacytoid cytoplasm, is CD20-negative/CD138-positive and often EBER-positive.
ALCL shows hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei and uniform strong CD30 with T-cell markers.

61014.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆分葉型嗜中性球的外緣緊貼著一圈（約 6–7 顆）血小板，像衛星環繞，即血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism）；這是 EDTA 採血管引起的體外現象，可造成自動計數的假性血小板低下。
features: Segmented neutrophil with 3-4 nuclear lobes and fine pink cytoplasmic granules
About six to seven platelets adherent around the neutrophil membrane, mostly along its lower and left border (rosetting)
Adherent platelets are normal in size and granularity
Few free platelets elsewhere in the background
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild overlap
61014.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and a mature segmented neutrophil in the center. Multiple normal-sized platelets are adherent to the neutrophil surface in a rosette-like arrangement, consistent with platelet satellitism, while relatively few free platelets are seen in the background. No platelet clumps, leukocyte inclusions or phagocytosed platelets are identified. This EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon can cause spurious thrombocytopenia (pseudothrombocytopenia); the platelet count should be verified on a citrated or fingerstick sample.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are aggregates of platelets among themselves at the feathered edge, not platelets ringing the surface of neutrophils.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within cytoplasmic vacuoles of the neutrophil rather than attached to the outer membrane.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without any rosetting, and the count does not normalize in citrate.
Chance overlap involves isolated platelets without a consistent circumferential ring around multiple leukocytes across the smear.

60950.recognize_zh: 觸印片中芽細胞成片、細胞質深嗜鹼性且布滿空泡，外觀像 Burkitt 細胞；但 C-MYC 免疫染色與核型圖（約 66 條染色體的近三倍體）顯示這是具 Burkitt 樣形態的 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Touch imprint: sheets of medium-to-large blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous discrete cytoplasmic (and overlying) vacuoles, mimicking Burkitt cells
Blasts with fine chromatin and variable nucleoli; background of fat-like droplets
Biopsy: hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of blasts with irregular nuclear contours
IHC: nuclear C-MYC positivity in a large proportion of blasts
Karyotype: near-triploid complement with many chromosomes present in three copies
60950.describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow biopsy shows cohesive-appearing sheets of blasts with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm, fine chromatin and variably visible nucleoli, closely resembling Burkitt-type cells. The core biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely replaced by sheets of blasts with irregular nuclear contours. C-MYC immunostain shows nuclear positivity in the majority of neoplastic cells. G-banded karyotype demonstrates a near-triploid chromosome complement. Given TdT and CD10 expression with absent surface light chain (per case data), findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with near-triploidy, which is biologically related to hypodiploid B-ALL, despite Burkitt-like morphology.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are TdT-negative, CD34-negative mature B cells with surface light-chain restriction and MYC rearrangement, whereas these blasts are TdT-positive with near-triploidy.
Hyperdiploid B-ALL has 51–65 chromosomes with gains of X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, 21 and a favorable prognosis, whereas near-triploidy (66–79) reflects doubled hypodiploid clone with TP53 mutation.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, blastoid
ddx.vs: Separated by TdT negativity, surface light-chain expression and FISH-confirmed MYC/BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts (e.g., monoblastic)
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO or nonspecific esterase positive and lack CD19/CD10/PAX5.

60950.stain: Wright-Giemsa imprint; H&E; IHC: C-MYC; G-banded karyotype

60886.recognize_zh: Desmin 免疫染色中，縱向走行、帶橫紋（cross-striation）的骨骼肌纖維強陽性可作為內部陽性對照，周圍片狀的小圓形腫瘤細胞胞質也呈棕色點狀/環狀陽性，支持肌源性分化的橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Three to four entrapped skeletal muscle fibers running vertically with strong desmin staining and visible cross-striations (internal positive control)
Sheets of densely packed tumor cells with round, hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Tumor cell cytoplasmic desmin positivity, often as perinuclear dot-like or rim-like brown deposits
Staining heterogeneous, with a subset of tumor cells weak or negative
No alveolar architecture assessable at this high-power field
60886.describe_en: Desmin immunohistochemistry on the primary soft-tissue mass shows sheets of discohesive-appearing small round tumor cells infiltrating between entrapped skeletal muscle fibers. The native muscle fibers are strongly desmin positive with preserved cross-striations, serving as an internal positive control. The majority of tumor cells show cytoplasmic desmin staining, frequently in a dot-like or perinuclear pattern, while a minority are weak. Findings support myogenic differentiation and are consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma, in keeping with the provided diagnosis of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma; myogenin/MyoD1 and FOXO1 rearrangement studies help confirm the alveolar subtype.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma is desmin and myogenin negative and expresses synaptophysin, PHOX2B and PGP9.5.
Ewing sarcoma shows membranous CD99 and nuclear NKX2.2 with EWSR1 rearrangement, and lacks nuclear myogenin (desmin is usually negative).
Lymphoblasts are TdT, CD34/CD99 and CD45 or CD19/CD3 positive and desmin negative.
Both are desmin positive; alveolar type shows diffuse strong myogenin and PAX3/PAX7::FOXO1 fusion, whereas embryonal type has patchy myogenin and fusion-negative status.

60822.recognize_zh: CD20 染色在許多大型、類何杰金樣的腫瘤細胞呈明顯膜狀陽性（部分帶核旁點狀加強），背景小淋巴球多為陰性；大細胞保有 B 細胞標記，是灰區淋巴瘤與典型何杰金淋巴瘤的重要區分點。
features: Numerous large cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei showing membranous CD20 staining
Variable intensity: some large cells strongly positive, others weak or granular cytoplasmic
Several positive cells show paranuclear dot-like accentuation
Large cells scattered singly and in loose clusters
Background small lymphoid and histiocytic cells largely CD20-negative
60822.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows membranous and cytoplasmic staining of numerous large atypical cells, with intensity ranging from strong to weak, while the background small lymphocytes are predominantly negative. Some positive large cells show paranuclear dot accentuation. Retention of CD20 in Hodgkin-like large cells, in combination with CD15 and CD30 expression elsewhere in the panel, supports a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD20-negative or only weakly positive in a minority of cells, whereas here many large cells express CD20.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background but lacks CD15 and CD30 expression.
LP cells are strongly CD20+ but CD15/CD30-negative and sit within CD20+ follicular dendritic meshworks with PD1+ T-cell rosettes.

60630.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有核分六葉以上的過度分葉中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），紅血球大小差異大、見大卵圓紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），同時混有淚滴細胞與碎片狀紅血球（schistocytes），易被誤認為 TTP，但過度分葉與巨卵圓紅血球提示維生素 B12 缺乏。
features: Hypersegmented neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes
Marked anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes alongside microcytic cells
Prominent poikilocytosis: schistocytes/fragments, teardrop cells, irregular and bite-like forms
Occasional polychromatophilic or dense-staining red cells
Platelets appear decreased in this field
60630.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and numerous red cell fragments resembling schistocytes. A hypersegmented neutrophil with six or more lobes is present, and platelets appear reduced. The combination of red cell fragmentation and thrombocytopenia can mimic a thrombotic microangiopathy, but hypersegmented neutrophils and macro-ovalocytes point to ineffective megaloblastic hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with severe vitamin B12 deficiency (pseudo-thrombotic microangiopathy); ADAMTS13 activity and B12/methylmalonic acid levels help confirm.

ddx.vs: TTP has schistocytes with a high reticulocyte count and severely reduced ADAMTS13, without macro-ovalocytes or hypersegmented neutrophils.
Folate deficiency is morphologically identical, so serum folate, B12 and methylmalonic acid levels are needed.
MDS may be macrocytic but shows hypolobated or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than hypersegmentation, and does not correct with B12.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells with a leukoerythroblastic picture and splenomegaly rather than hypersegmented neutrophils.

60694.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以紅血球前驅細胞為主，可見含多個核、細胞質深藍的巨大多核紅血球母細胞、雙核與巨母細胞樣（megaloblastoid）核，以及帶細胞質泡突的原紅血球母細胞，屬於極度紅系造血異常，符合急性紅血球白血病背景。
features: Marked erythroid predominance with many pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts showing deep royal-blue cytoplasm and fine-to-stippled chromatin
Giant multinucleated erythroid precursor with four or more nuclei in abundant deep blue cytoplasm (A)
Binucleate and megaloblastoid erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (B)
Pronormoblast with cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods (C, black arrow)
Very large round homogeneous gray body with an adjacent faint ghost-like structure (C, red arrow), nature not determinable at this resolution
60694.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a striking predominance of erythroid precursors with severe dyserythropoiesis. There are giant multinucleated erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, binucleate and megaloblastoid forms, and numerous pronormoblasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebbing. An unusually large homogeneous round body and a pale ghost-like structure are also present, whose nature cannot be established from this image alone. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia) with extreme dyserythropoiesis; quantification of pronormoblasts, E-cadherin/CD71 staining and TP53 studies are appropriate.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows orderly maturation with open chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, lacks a proliferation of pronormoblasts, and reverses with vitamin replacement.
MDS shows dyserythropoiesis with maturing erythroids, but pronormoblasts do not reach the ≥30% threshold of pure erythroid leukemia.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and absent maturing erythroids, without multinucleation or leukemic expansion.
CDA has bi-/multinucleated erythroblasts and internuclear bridges but orderly maturation, no blast excess, and a lifelong congenital course.

captions: Giant multinucleated erythroid precursor with deep basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid hyperplasia with binucleate and megaloblastoid precursors
Pronormoblast with cytoplasmic blebs (black arrow) and a ghost-like structure beside a large round body (red arrow)

60438.recognize_zh: 稀少細胞的骨髓抹片中，中央有一顆雙核的不成熟細胞，兩核大小相近、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍且邊緣有泡狀突起，最可能為雙核的早期紅血球前驅細胞（發育異常），周圍只見少量小淋巴球。
features: Paucicellular aspirate with predominance of red cells and few nucleated cells
Central large binucleated cell with two similar round nuclei and fine to slightly granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular blebs/projections, consistent with an early erythroid precursor
Adjacent cell with round nucleus and finely stippled chromatin (possible erythroid precursor)
Scattered small mature lymphocytes; no granulocytic precursors or blast clusters in this field
60438.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is paucicellular and composed mainly of red cells with few nucleated elements, predominantly small lymphocytes. A large binucleated immature cell with two symmetric round nuclei, fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs is present, most in keeping with a dysplastic binucleated early erythroid precursor. A single dysplastic cell is not sufficient to establish dysplasia, and the paucicellular aspirate limits assessment. In the context of a hypocellular marrow and pancytopenia in a child, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts are giant with large glassy intranuclear inclusions and are accompanied by red cell aplasia, not binucleation.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear clearing away from the nucleus, and plasma cells have clumped clock-face chromatin with a perinuclear hof.
Aplastic anemia aspirates are hypocellular but lack clearly dysplastic erythroid or megakaryocytic forms.
Megaloblastic change affects multiple lineages with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, and it corrects with B12/folate.

60374.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，密集的中型芽細胞具細緻染色質、圓形至不規則核與稀少細胞質，並可見數個有絲分裂，零星夾雜深染的紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，符合 B-ALL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Densely packed sheets of medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular nuclei, some with indentations, with finely dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures scattered through the infiltrate
Few residual erythroid precursors and scattered brown hemosiderin deposits; megakaryocytes not evident
60374.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized blasts with scant cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, with frequent mitotic figures. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes are not evident, and hemosiderin deposits are present focally. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia, supported by the CD34/TdT/CD79a/CD10-positive immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps on H&E; myeloid markers (MPO, CD117, CD33) without B-lineage markers indicate AML.
Indistinguishable on H&E; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and absence of CD79a/PAX5 define T lineage.
Burkitt has more basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, a starry-sky pattern and a TdT-/CD34- mature B phenotype.

60182.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中央兩顆顆粒球前驅細胞（後骨髓細胞／帶狀核）核型已接近成熟，胞質卻呈淡灰藍色、幾乎沒有顆粒，這種顆粒減少（hypogranular）是典型的顆粒球發育不良；周圍另有數顆紅血球系前驅細胞。
features: Hypogranular granulocytic precursors: metamyelocyte with a kidney-shaped nucleus and pale gray, nearly agranular cytoplasm
Second hypogranular precursor with a deeply indented, band-like to bilobed nucleus
Several erythroid precursors (polychromatic and basophilic normoblasts) with round dense nuclei and blue cytoplasm
A granulated promyelocyte/myelocyte at upper left and a large immature cell at bottom edge
Blasts not clearly increased in this field; blast count requires a full differential
60182.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with striking hypogranulation, including a metamyelocyte and a band-like form with pale gray, nearly agranular cytoplasm despite nuclear maturation. Scattered polychromatic and basophilic normoblasts and a normally granulated promyelocyte are also present, and a large immature cell is partly seen at the bottom edge. Dysgranulopoiesis is evident; with 5% blasts on the aspirate differential, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts (former RAEB-1).

ddx.vs: Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and folded lacy chromatin, while hypogranular metamyelocytes retain coarser clumped granulocytic chromatin.
Poor staining causes uniform loss of granule color in all cells, whereas here adjacent promyelocytes retain granules, confirming true hypogranulation.
Reactive precursors show normal or toxic granulation rather than agranular cytoplasm and lack clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

ddx.dx: MDS with low blasts / single lineage dysplasia
ddx.vs: Separation from MDS-EB depends on blast count (<5% marrow and <2% blood) rather than dysplasia morphology.

60118.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（影像標註低倍，但實際放大倍率較高）中造血區由單形性、核深染而形狀不規則的小到中型細胞成片占據，細胞質少，殘存的嗜酸性顆粒球與紅系細胞零散分布於脂肪空泡間。
features: Interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of small to medium-sized immature cells between fat spaces
High N:C ratio with irregular, focally convoluted hyperchromatic nuclei
Scant cytoplasm and fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Residual eosinophilic granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells scattered in the periphery
Fat spaces retained; overall cellularity cannot be fully judged from this field
60118.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (labeled low power, although the field is at intermediate magnification) shows a hematopoietic area in which normal elements are largely replaced by a monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized immature cells with high N:C ratio, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Residual eosinophilic granulocyte precursors and erythroid cells are scattered at the edges, and fat spaces are retained. Megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by lymphoblastic leukemia, supported by immunophenotyping as T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mature T-cell lymphomas are TdT/CD34/CD1a negative with more pleomorphic nuclei and often associated fibrosis; immunohistochemistry is required.
Histology is identical; PAX5/CD79a versus CD3 immunostains separate lineage.
Aplastic marrow is markedly hypocellular with small mature lymphocytes and plasma cells, not sheets of immature blasts.

60054.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖先以 SSC 對 CD15 圈出顆粒球，再看 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59：正常人顆粒球落在雙陽性象限（99.75%），而本例 98.60% 的顆粒球落在 FLAER 與 CD55/59 雙陰性象限，代表大型 PNH 克隆。
features: Two-column comparison of a normal control and the patient sample
Granulocytes gated on SSC versus CD15 (red population, high SSC, CD15 bright)
Normal control: 99.75% of granulocytes are FLAER-positive and CD55/CD59-positive
Patient: 98.60% of granulocytes are FLAER-negative and CD55/CD59-negative (GPI-anchor deficient)
Small residual 0.18% double-positive normal granulocytes in the patient; overall clone involves over 98% of granulocytes
60054.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood compares a normal control with the patient sample. Granulocytes are gated on side scatter versus CD15 and then assessed for FLAER binding and expression of the GPI-anchored proteins CD55 and CD59. In the normal control, nearly all granulocytes (99.75%) are FLAER and CD55/CD59 positive, whereas in the patient 98.60% of granulocytes lack both FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression. Findings demonstrate a large PNH clone involving more than 98% of granulocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria arising in the setting of aplastic anemia.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Many aplastic anemia patients have minor GPI-deficient populations (often <10%), whereas this clone replaces nearly all granulocytes, indicating a clinically significant PNH clone.
Isolated inherited deficiency affects a single antigen on all cells, whereas FLAER negativity together with loss of both CD55 and CD59 indicates a global GPI-anchor defect from PIGA mutation.

ddx.dx: Technical artifact from poor gating or reagent failure
ddx.vs: Artifact is excluded by the normal control run in parallel and by the residual small population of normal FLAER-positive granulocytes in the patient.

12694.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球胞質邊緣可見淡藍色、梭形的 Döhle 樣包涵體（實心箭頭，插圖亦同），而血小板大到接近紅血球大小、中央有顆粒（空心箭頭）；巨大血小板加上顆粒球包涵體，是 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin anomaly）的典型組合。
features: Giant platelets approaching or equaling red cell diameter, with central purple granulomere (open arrows)
Neutrophils with pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions near the cell periphery (solid arrows and insets)
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal, without toxic granulation or vacuolation
Apparent reduction in platelet number
Red cells normocytic and normochromic
12694.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows giant platelets, many approaching the size of adjacent red cells, with an apparent decrease in platelet number. Neutrophils contain pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolation. Red cells are unremarkable. In a patient with a positive family history, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder); immunofluorescence for aggregated non-muscle myosin IIA and MYH9 genetic testing confirm the diagnosis, and automated counts may underestimate platelets.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation and vacuolation in a clinical inflammatory setting and are not associated with inherited giant platelets.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets but no neutrophil inclusions and absent ristocetin-induced aggregation (GPIb-IX-V deficiency).
Gray platelets are large but pale and agranular, and neutrophils lack Döhle-like inclusions.
ITP shows modestly enlarged platelets without neutrophil inclusions or family history, and platelet size is less uniformly giant.

21270.recognize_zh: 組織切片中成片的組織球細胞質內塞滿許多細小、大小一致的圓形小體，每顆周圍有淡色空暈（halo），夾雜淋巴球與纖維間質，這種「組織球內滿是小酵母菌」的樣子是組織胞漿菌症的特徵。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant granular to bubbly eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cytoplasm packed with numerous uniform tiny round to oval bodies (about 2-4 um) with clear halos
Histiocyte nuclei oval and vesicular, displaced by the organisms
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells in fibrous stroma
No well-formed necrotizing granulomas in this field
21270.describe_en: Tissue section shows effacement by sheets of histiocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm distended by numerous small, uniform, round-to-oval intracellular organisms surrounded by clear halos. Scattered lymphocytes and plasma cells are present in a fibrous background, and well-formed necrotizing granulomas are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); confirmation with GMS or PAS stains, culture, antigen testing, and assessment of immune status are recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a bar-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and are GMS/PAS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a halo, and they are GMS-negative.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger with budding and no halo, and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy alveolar exudate.

17942.recognize_zh: 手背（日光曝曬處）可見多發水疱、糜爛、結痂與色素沉著/疤痕，C 圖尿液日光下呈紅棕色、紫外光下呈粉紅螢光（正常尿為藍綠），符合遲發性皮膚紫質症（porphyria cutanea tarda）。
features: Clinical photographs, not a microscopic image
Panel A-B: dorsal hands with multiple vesicles/bullae, erosions, crusts and hyperpigmented scars on sun-exposed skin
Panel B close-up: purplish healing lesions and atrophic scars consistent with skin fragility
Panel C: PCT urine is reddish-brown in daylight versus yellow normal urine
Panel C: PCT urine shows pink-red fluorescence under UV light, whereas normal urine does not
17942.describe_en: Clinical photographs (Balwani and Desnick, Hematology 2012) show the dorsal hands with multiple blisters, erosions, crusted lesions and hyperpigmented atrophic scars confined to sun-exposed skin, reflecting chronic blistering photosensitivity and skin fragility. Panel C shows urine that is reddish-brown in daylight and fluoresces pink-red under ultraviolet light compared with normal urine, reflecting markedly increased uroporphyrin and heptacarboxyl porphyrin excretion. Findings are consistent with porphyria cutanea tarda; plasma porphyrin fluorescence scan and urine porphyrin fractionation confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Skin lesions are identical, but VP shows a plasma fluorescence peak at about 626 nm with fecal protoporphyrin elevation and both can cause acute neurovisceral attacks.
Pseudoporphyria produces the same blisters but urine and plasma porphyrins are normal.
EPP causes immediate painful phototoxicity without blisters or scarring, and urine porphyrins are normal because protoporphyrin is not water-soluble.
EBA shows trauma-induced blisters with normal porphyrins and linear IgG at the dermal-epidermal junction on immunofluorescence.

16214.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸液肉眼呈黑褐色（A、B），抹片中大型腫瘤細胞的細胞質充滿深藍黑色的粗大色素顆粒（黑色素，melanin），CT 顯示肝脾多發低密度病灶，符合轉移性黑色素瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Panels A–B (gross): black-brown pigmented aspirate within the syringe/tube and on smears
Panel C (CT): multiple hypodense lesions in the liver and spleen
Panels D–E (BM aspirate): large cells with abundant pale to grayish cytoplasm packed with coarse blue-black to greenish-black pigment granules
Large round nuclei with open chromatin and visible nucleoli; pigment partly overlies the nucleus
Background of normal granulocytic precursors, lymphocytes and red cells
16214.describe_en: Grossly, the bone marrow aspirate and resulting smears are dark brown-black (panels A–B), and CT imaging shows multiple hypodense hepatic and splenic lesions (panel C). The aspirate smears (panels D–E) contain large, non-hematopoietic-appearing cells with abundant cytoplasm filled with coarse blue-black pigment granules, large round nuclei with open chromatin and nucleoli, amid residual normal hematopoietic cells. Cohesive clusters are not clearly shown in these fields. Findings are consistent with metastatic malignant melanoma involving the bone marrow; confirmation with melanocytic IHC (SOX10, S100, HMB-45, Melan-A) and a negative Prussian blue stain for the pigment is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin appears as golden-brown to blue-green refractile granules that are strongly Prussian blue positive, whereas melanin is Prussian blue negative and Fontana-Masson positive, in cells with malignant nuclei.
Sea-blue histiocytes have bland small nuclei and uniform blue ceroid granules without gross black discoloration of the aspirate.
CHS shows giant azurophilic granules within granulocytes and lymphocytes of normal hematopoietic lineage, not large pigmented non-hematopoietic cells.
Mast cell granules are purple metachromatic and tryptase/CD117 positive, and the cells lack the large atypical nuclei and gross black aspirate of melanoma.

2710.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨大的多核巨噬細胞，三個小而圓的核分布在淡藍灰、帶細纖維紋路的豐富細胞質中，呈皺紙狀外觀，符合高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Giant histiocyte with three small round-to-oval nuclei
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary/wrinkled texture
Nuclei have moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Irregular cell border with cytoplasmic projections
No phagocytosed red cells or discrete vacuoles; normal surrounding marrow elements
2710.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant multinucleated histiocyte with three small round nuclei embedded in abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm that has a fine fibrillary, wrinkled texture. The surrounding hematopoietic cells appear unremarkable, and no hemophagocytosis is identified. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, supporting Gaucher disease in the appropriate context; enzyme assay and GBA1 testing are required to exclude pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes in CML, myeloma, or thalassemia look similar but have normal glucocerebrosidase activity and an associated primary disorder.
Osteoclasts contain many more uniform nuclei in granular, more basophilic cytoplasm without fibrillary striations.
Niemann-Pick cells show uniform small lipid vacuoles (soap-bubble appearance) rather than striated cytoplasm.

12566.recognize_zh: 抹片中央與右下各見一個含空泡、胞質淡染的巨噬細胞，外圍緊貼一圈深藍色、圓核的紅母細胞，排列成玫瑰花環狀，這就是紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island）的「保母細胞」結構。
features: Central macrophages with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus
Rosette of erythroblasts in intimate contact with the macrophage cytoplasm
Surrounding erythroblasts are small to intermediate with round dense nuclei and deeply basophilic to polychromatophilic cytoplasm
Three separate islands of varying size, the largest (lower right) with more than one layer of precursors
Scattered isolated erythroblasts and a blood-rich background; no blasts or abnormal lymphoid cells in this field
12566.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several erythroblastic islands, each composed of a central macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm encircled by one or more layers of erythroblasts at various stages of maturation. The erythroid precursors show orderly maturation without megaloblastic or dysplastic change. No leukemic blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with prominent erythroblastic islands, a reactive feature reflecting active or stressed erythropoiesis, here in a post-transplant marrow in morphologic remission.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the red cell precursors are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm rather than arranged around its surface.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters form cohesive sheets of uniform malignant cells without a central macrophage and lack hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts show fine chromatin, scant agranular cytoplasm and lie singly, not in rosettes with maturing hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

11862.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片可見淋巴球明顯增多，許多小至中型淋巴球核形不規則、帶切痕或分葉，染色質濃縮；背景仍見嗜中性球與一顆嗜酸性球，低倍即可察覺淋巴球增多並提示 ATLL。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis with numerous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells in a low-power field
Many lymphocytes show irregular, notched or lobulated nuclear contours
Condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; nucleoli not evident at this magnification
Scattered normal neutrophils and one eosinophil
Red cells normocytic; platelets present
11862.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows increased numbers of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells relative to granulocytes. Many of the lymphocytes have irregular, notched to lobulated nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, although fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Neutrophils, an eosinophil, red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are suggestive of a mature T-cell leukemia such as adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; high-power review, HTLV-1 serology and flow cytometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are round-nucleated small lymphocytes with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+CD23+ B cells, lacking lobulated nuclei.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei and occur with erythroderma and HTLV-1 negativity, whereas ATLL shows polylobated flower-like nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytosis is polymorphous with large granular or plasmacytoid forms and lacks a monotonous population of lobulated lymphocytes.

5846.recognize_zh: 芽細胞核圓、染色質細緻並有核仁；視野中央與右側各有一個芽細胞把深染小圓核的有核細胞包進空泡，核被推到一邊，屬芽細胞吞噬血球（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Sheet of medium to large blasts with round nuclei, high N:C ratio and fine chromatin
One to two prominent nucleoli in many blasts
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm with occasional fine granules
At least two blasts containing engulfed nucleated cells (dense round nuclei with a thin rim of cytoplasm) within clear vacuoles, displacing the host nucleus
Occasional granulated myeloid cell (upper right) and background red cells
5846.describe_en: Smear shows sheets of blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Two blasts contain phagocytosed nucleated cells within clear vacuoles, compressing and displacing the host nucleus. No mature macrophages are responsible for the phagocytosis in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia showing hemophagocytosis by blasts; correlation with monocytic immunophenotype and cytogenetics, including t(8;16), is advised.

ddx.vs: In HLH the phagocytes are mature benign histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and bland nuclei rather than blasts with nucleoli.
This genetic subtype is the classic cause of blast hemophagocytosis and is confirmed only by karyotype or FISH/molecular testing.
Erythroblastic islands show a central macrophage surrounded by maturing erythroblasts, not blasts containing intracytoplasmic engulfed cells.

5910.recognize_zh: 一群異常前骨髓細胞，核不規則或折疊，細胞質內可見成束交錯的 Auer 小體（柴束細胞 faggot cell），並有粗大嗜天青顆粒，這是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL, PML::RARA）的典型形態。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with irregular, folded to reniform nuclei
Moderate N:C ratio; nuclear outlines partly obscured by granules
Multiple Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles within the cytoplasm (faggot cells)
Abundant cytoplasm with coarse azurophilic granules, some cells with a clear ectoplasmic rim
Background of normocytic red cells without other obvious leukocytes
5910.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with irregular, folded nuclei and abundant cytoplasm packed with azurophilic granules. Several cells contain multiple Auer rods arranged in bundles (faggot cells), and one cell shows coarse granules with a clear ectoplasmic rim. Normal maturing granulocytes are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation screening for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts in t(8;21) typically have a single long slender Auer rod and a salmon-colored perinuclear hof, not bundles of Auer rods in hypergranular cells.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or invisible granules and rare Auer rods, unlike the heavily granulated faggot cells here.
Reactive promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and orderly maturation, and never contain Auer rods.

ddx.dx: APL variant with RARA partner other than PML (e.g. ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, but ZBTB16::RARA cases have more regular nuclei and fewer Auer rods and are ATRA-resistant, so molecular testing is required.

3734.recognize_zh: 下方嗜中性球的細胞膜外圍黏附一圈血小板排成花環狀（rosette），上方嗜中性球周邊也有數個血小板貼附，這就是 EDTA 引起的血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），可造成偽性血小板低下。
features: Neutrophil ringed by numerous adherent platelets forming a rosette around the cell membrane
Second neutrophil with several platelets attached at its periphery
Platelets are normal in size and granulation
Neutrophils mature, segmented, with normal nuclear and cytoplasmic features
Few free platelets in the background; red cells unremarkable
3734.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils with platelets adhering to their surfaces; one neutrophil is completely rimmed by a rosette of normal-sized platelets, while the second has several attached platelets. Free platelets in the background are relatively few, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; recollection in citrate or heparin, or a fingerstick smear, is recommended to obtain an accurate platelet count.

ddx.vs: Clumping forms free platelet aggregates in the background and at the feathered edge rather than rosettes around neutrophils; both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
In phagocytosis platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, often in vacuoles, rather than adhering to the outer membrane.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without satellitism or clumps and persists when the count is repeated in citrate.

1238.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞（核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等）與具粗大嗜天青顆粒的前骨髓球／骨髓球混雜，並有少數成熟嗜中性球，顯示母細胞增生同時仍有顆粒球分化，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by blasts with round nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Blasts with scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, some with a few azurophilic granules
Admixed promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules
Occasional segmented neutrophils and a mitotic figure
Paucity of erythroid precursors; Auer rods not clearly identified at this magnification
1238.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular and dominated by blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, some containing a few azurophilic granules. There is admixed granulocytic maturation, including promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules and occasional segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are sparse, and Auer rods are not clearly seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, provided blasts are at least 20% with at least 10% maturing granulocytic cells; cytogenetic and molecular studies, including RUNX1::RUNX1T1, are needed for classification.

ddx.vs: APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells), rather than a mixture of blasts with orderly maturing granulocytes.
AML without maturation has less than 10% maturing granulocytic cells, whereas this field shows readily identifiable promyelocytes, myelocytes and neutrophils.
MDS-IB has fewer than 20% blasts with multilineage dysplasia, requiring an accurate differential count to separate from AML.
Recovery after chemotherapy or G-CSF shows a synchronous wave of promyelocytes and myelocytes with few true blasts and normal maturation.

1302.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一個邊界清楚、非小樑旁的大型淋巴聚集（lymphoid aggregate），中心細胞較淡、周邊較密，內含小血管，周圍為正常三系造血與脂肪，符合骨髓內反應性淋巴濾泡/生發中心。
features: Large, well-circumscribed lymphoid aggregate located in the intertrabecular (non-paratrabecular) space
Composed predominantly of small, round, dark lymphocytes
Slightly paler central zone with admixed red cells and small vessels, suggestive of a germinal center at low power
Surrounding marrow shows preserved trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and fat
Bony trabeculae without paratrabecular lymphoid infiltration
1302.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows normocellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a single large, well-circumscribed intertrabecular lymphoid aggregate. The aggregate is composed mainly of small lymphocytes with a slightly paler central zone and small vessels, but a definite germinal center with centroblasts and tingible-body macrophages cannot be confirmed at this magnification. There is no paratrabecular or diffuse interstitial lymphoid infiltration. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid aggregate, possibly with germinal center formation; immunohistochemistry is helpful to confirm.

ddx.vs: FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of centrocytes that are BCL2-positive, whereas this aggregate is intertrabecular and well circumscribed.
CLL aggregates are often multiple, non-circumscribed and composed of CD5+/CD23+ small cells with proliferation centers, not a single aggregate with a germinal center.
MZL may colonize reactive germinal centers but shows light-chain restricted monocytoid/marginal zone cells and often intrasinusoidal spread.
MCL aggregates are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and lack true germinal centers.

1174.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒周邊細胞量豐富，以各階段成熟中的顆粒球（骨髓球、帶狀核、分節核）為主，芽細胞不多、成熟順序完整，符合反應性骨髓（顆粒球增生）。
features: Cellular marrow particle edge with interspersed fat vacuoles
Predominance of maturing granulocytic cells: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Orderly, full-spectrum maturation without an increase in blasts
Scattered erythroid precursors with round nuclei and dense chromatin
No overt dysplasia or abnormal cell population in this field
1174.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular particles with interspersed fat. Hematopoietic elements are dominated by maturing granulocytic cells showing orderly progression from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with scattered erythroid precursors. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysplasia or abnormal infiltrate is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a reactive marrow with granulocytic predominance; correlation with clinical history (infection, inflammation, growth factor therapy) is recommended.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked hypercellularity with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and is confirmed by BCR::ABL1.
MDS shows dysplasia such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and may have increased blasts, which are not seen here.
CNL shows sustained mature neutrophilia with a CSF3R mutation and no reactive cause, which requires clinical and molecular exclusion.

1110.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 PAS 染色中，許多細胞胞質內有強烈洋紅色的圓球狀包涵體，有些呈一串葡萄狀，是 PAS 陽性的 Russell bodies，代表大量 Mott 細胞。
features: Numerous cells with intensely magenta, PAS-positive globular cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions range from single large homogeneous globes to clusters of small grape-like spheres
Nuclei compressed or obscured by the inclusions
Background small lymphoid and hematopoietic cells between fat spaces
Megakaryocyte with pale lilac cytoplasm (upper right) and focal golden-brown pigment (hemosiderin)
1110.describe_en: PAS-stained section of bone marrow biopsy shows numerous cells containing intensely magenta, PAS-positive cytoplasmic globules, ranging from single large homogeneous spheres to clusters of smaller grape-like spheres that compress the nuclei. These are Russell bodies within Mott cells, set in an interstitial background of small lymphoid and hematopoietic cells with scattered megakaryocytes and focal hemosiderin pigment. The findings indicate a marked plasmacytic component with Russell body formation, which can accompany marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation; light chain IHC or ISH is required to assess clonality.

ddx.vs: Erythroid PAS positivity is block-like or finely granular within small erythroblasts with round central nuclei, not large discrete globules.
Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and paler, homogeneous lilac PAS staining.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cells
ddx.vs: Myeloma forms sheets of plasma cells without a significant small lymphocyte component and is monotypic by light chain stains.

4246.recognize_zh: 脂肪細胞間的造血細胞以免疫染色標示，許多細胞呈棕色陽性（箭頭處），陰性細胞則為藍色背景，證明脂肪之間確實是有分化的骨髓造血成分，支持腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Adipocytes with hematopoietic cells in the intervening stroma
Numerous cells with strong brown granular cytoplasmic staining (arrow)
Admixed negative cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain, including small round erythroid-like nuclei
Occasional larger negative cells with vesicular nuclei
Specific antibody not labeled; staining pattern is compatible with a myeloid marker
4246.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a fat-rich lesion shows hematopoietic cells situated between adipocytes, with many cells showing strong brown granular cytoplasmic positivity (arrow) admixed with negative cells. The staining pattern is compatible with a myeloid lineage marker such as MPO, although the antibody is not labeled. The presence of maturing hematopoietic lineages within mature fat supports a diagnosis of adrenal myelolipoma in the appropriate anatomic setting.

ddx.vs: EMH contains similar lineages but lacks the mass of mature adipose tissue and arises in the setting of marrow failure or chronic hemolysis.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of sheets of immature blasts (CD34/CD117 positive) rather than maturing trilineage elements in fat.

4182.recognize_zh: 表皮下真皮被成片單形性細胞填滿，細胞核圓到卵圓位於中央、胞質豐富淡嗜酸性且邊界清楚（煎蛋樣），其間散在嗜酸性球，這是皮膚肥大細胞增生症（如肥大細胞瘤）的形態。
features: Sheets of monomorphic cells in the dermis beneath the basal epidermis
Round to oval central nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct borders (fried-egg appearance)
Scattered eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and red granules
Occasional binucleate cells; no significant mitotic activity or necrosis
4182.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate extending up to the dermoepidermal junction. The infiltrate consists of monomorphic cells with round to oval central nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with well-defined borders, imparting a fried-egg appearance. Scattered eosinophils are admixed, and there is no significant atypia or mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with cutaneous mastocytosis (mastocytoma-type infiltrate); confirmation with tryptase or CD117 immunostain is recommended.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, reniform (coffee-bean) nuclei, often epidermotropic, and are CD1a/langerin-positive rather than tryptase/CD117-positive.
Melanocytic lesions show nesting, maturation and S100/SOX10 positivity.
JXG contains foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells and is CD68/CD163-positive, tryptase-negative.
Monocytic leukemia cutis shows folded nuclei and a lysozyme/CD68/CD33-positive population with a separate systemic leukemia.

4054.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的病灶由梭形到卵圓形、胞質淡嗜酸性的細胞組成，伴隨纖維化，中央包著一團深染的小淋巴球聚集，周圍骨髓有嗜酸性球；這種「淋巴聚集被梭形肥大細胞包圍」的病灶是系統性肥大細胞增生症的典型切片表現。
features: Paratrabecular/perivascular lesion adjacent to bone
Spindled to ovoid cells with oval bland nuclei and pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Central dense aggregate of small dark lymphocytes within the lesion
Associated reticulin-type fibrosis and loose collagenous stroma
Surrounding cellular marrow with fat spaces and scattered eosinophils
4054.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a focal lesion adjacent to a bony trabecula composed of spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, set in fibrotic stroma. A central aggregate of small mature lymphocytes is present within the lesion, and eosinophils are seen in the surrounding cellular marrow. This mixed lesion, with spindle cells encircling a lymphoid aggregate, is characteristic of a mast cell lesion. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are composed of lymphocytes alone without a surrounding cuff of spindled tryptase-positive mast cells and fibrosis.
Granulomas contain epithelioid histiocytes with plump nuclei and often giant cells, which are CD68-positive and tryptase-negative.
PMF shows diffuse fibrosis with atypical clustered megakaryocytes rather than a discrete spindle cell nodule.
Lymphoma nodules are dominated by monotonous clonal lymphoid cells, and the spindle cells are not mast cells.

4118.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球有淡藍色胞質與明顯粗大的嗜天青顆粒，核呈腎形略凹陷、染色質濃縮，這是典型的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；需以流式與 TCR 克隆性確認是否為 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Lymphocyte slightly larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Coarse, distinct azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Reniform, slightly indented nucleus with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Background normochromic red cells and scattered platelets
4118.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with a reniform nucleus, condensed chromatin and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules. The red cells are normochromic with scattered platelets in the background. A single LGL is not diagnostic; a persistent LGL count greater than 2 x 10^9/L with a clonal CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ population, often with STAT3 mutation, would be consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical and are separated only by polyclonal TCR studies and transient course.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs are surface CD3-negative and CD16+/CD56+ by flow cytometry.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and fine dusty granules, and promyelocytes have nucleoli with abundant granular basophilic cytoplasm.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections, oval nuclei with open chromatin and no azurophilic granules.

3990.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散布大量核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）且細胞質深藍的漿細胞，並夾雜較大、核仁明顯的未成熟漿細胞，其餘為顆粒球與紅血球系；漿細胞明顯增多符合多發性骨髓瘤復發。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm; some larger immature plasma cells with finer chromatin and nucleoli
Occasional binucleate plasma cell forms
Admixed maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and a mitotic figure (top center)
Fat vacuoles at the edges; background otherwise cellular
3990.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a conspicuous increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, perinuclear clearing and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. A subset are larger with finer chromatin and visible nucleoli, consistent with immature plasma cells. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present, along with a mitotic figure. In a patient with known plasma cell myeloma, findings are consistent with relapsed multiple myeloma; a plasma cell differential count and confirmation of clonality by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually fewer than 10%, often perivascular, and polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Early erythroblasts have round central nuclei and deep blue cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof or eccentric nucleus.

3862.recognize_zh: 這個視野以紅血球為主，箭頭指著一顆明顯比旁邊淋巴球大的異常細胞，核大、染色質細緻、胞質中等藍色；單看這一顆只能說是非典型大淋巴樣細胞，需要配合其他視野才能支持 DLBCL 侵犯。
features: Single large atypical mononuclear cell (arrow) with high N:C ratio
Large round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely granular chromatin
Moderate rim of pale to medium blue agranular cytoplasm
Field is predominantly red cells with a normal-appearing lymphocyte/monocytoid cell at top right for size comparison
Hematopoietic precursors are scarce in this field, limiting assessment of marrow involvement
3862.describe_en: Smear from the stated bone marrow aspirate shows a blood-rich field with only rare nucleated cells, including a large atypical mononuclear cell (arrow) with a high N:C ratio, finely granular chromatin and a moderate rim of agranular blue cytoplasm. A smaller mononuclear cell at the upper right provides size comparison. Hematopoietic precursors are sparse, so this field is hemodiluted and resembles peripheral blood. A single atypical large cell is suggestive of but not diagnostic for involvement by large B-cell lymphoma; evaluation of cellular particles, flow cytometry and core biopsy are required.

ddx.vs: A single large cell cannot be separated from a blast by morphology alone; CD34/TdT versus CD19/CD20 with light chain restriction on flow cytometry resolves it.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocyte or large granular lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, and LGLs have azurophilic granules, both absent in this cell.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and promyelocytes contain abundant azurophilic granules.

3798.recognize_zh: 高倍可見大量細胞質淡粉紅、核呈卵圓折疊或有核溝的樹突細胞與組織球（interdigitating／Langerhans cell），夾雜小淋巴球與少數嗜酸性球，符合皮膚病性淋巴結病的副皮質區組成。
features: Numerous histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval, folded or grooved vesicular nuclei with delicate chromatin and small nucleoli (interdigitating dendritic and Langerhans cells)
Admixed small mature lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Scattered eosinophils with bright red cytoplasmic granules
No obvious melanin pigment or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in this field
3798.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node paracortex shows numerous histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved nuclei with fine chromatin, consistent with interdigitating dendritic cells and Langerhans cells. These are admixed with small lymphocytes and scattered eosinophils. Melanin pigment and clusters of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; in patients with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, TCR clonality studies are advised.

ddx.vs: LCH forms confluent sheets of CD1a+ grooved cells, often sinusoidal with eosinophilic abscesses and necrosis, effacing the node.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters of atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic cerebriform nuclei and clonal TCR rearrangement.
IDC sarcoma forms fascicles or whorls of cytologically atypical S100+ cells with effacement, rather than a mixed reactive paracortex.

3670.recognize_zh: 化療後骨髓顆粒中造血細胞稀少，主要是脂肪空泡、淡紫色基質、梭形基質細胞與含深色含鐵血黃素顆粒的巨噬細胞，僅殘留少數巨核細胞，呈現骨髓低細胞、以間質為主的治療後變化。
features: Marrow particle composed largely of fat vacuoles and pale purple stromal ground substance
Markedly reduced hematopoietic precursors within the particle
Spindled and stellate stromal cells with streaming nuclei
Macrophages containing dark coarse hemosiderin/debris granules
A few residual large megakaryocytes and scattered small lymphoid or plasma cells
No clusters of blasts identified in this field
3670.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed predominantly of fat and stromal elements, including spindled stromal cells, pale ground substance and macrophages laden with dark pigment granules. Hematopoietic precursors are markedly reduced, with only a few residual megakaryocytes and scattered small mononuclear cells; no aggregates of blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular, stroma-rich post-chemotherapy marrow; assessment of residual disease requires a trephine biopsy for cellularity and flow cytometry or molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Shows a similarly fat- and stroma-rich hypocellular particle, so the distinction depends on the history of cytotoxic therapy rather than morphology.
Would show dysplastic residual hematopoiesis or clusters of blasts, which require high-power review, CD34 immunostaining and flow cytometry to exclude.
Features abundant amorphous pink-purple extracellular mucopolysaccharide material with fat atrophy, typically in cachexia, rather than cellular stroma with pigment-laden macrophages.

3478.recognize_zh: 一團緊密黏附的大型非造血細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、部分帶尾狀突起，核圓且偏位、大小相近，細胞間邊界互相貼合；這種黏聚性細胞團與周圍造血細胞明顯不同，應想到轉移性癌（此例為膀胱尿路上皮癌）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with molded, closely apposed cell borders
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, some cells with tapering cytoplasmic tails
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with fine granular chromatin and mild size variation
Cells much larger than the adjacent hematopoietic cells in the field
Background of clumped red cells and scattered residual marrow cells
3478.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, focal tapering cytoplasmic tails, and round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin. The cells are tightly apposed with molded borders and are distinctly larger than the few adjacent hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; in the appropriate clinical setting this is compatible with metastatic urothelial carcinoma, which should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy with keratin, GATA3, and p63 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof but occur as dispersed cells rather than cohesive molded clusters, and they are CD138+ keratin-negative.
Osteoblasts have a paranuclear clear zone separated from the nucleus and occur in children or bone remodeling, lacking atypia and keratin expression.
Mucin vacuoles or glandular arrangement suggest adenocarcinoma, and site of origin requires an IHC panel (e.g., GATA3 and uroplakin for urothelial, CDX2 for colorectal).

3350.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，大型腫瘤細胞呈現強陽性的細胞膜染色，加上核旁點狀（Golgi dot）染色，背景小淋巴球與基質細胞為陰性；這種「膜＋高基氏體」的型態是 CD30 的典型表現，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Large tumor cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular, often indented nuclei
Strong brown membranous staining outlining individual large cells
Paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) accentuation in many positive cells
Granular cytoplasmic staining in a subset of cells
Background small lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells are negative
Positive cells arranged in loose clusters and cords
3350.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows numerous large atypical cells arranged in clusters and cords. The large cells show strong membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-zone dot accentuation and granular cytoplasmic positivity, whereas background small lymphocytes and spindle stromal cells are negative. The antibody is not labeled; this membrane-plus-Golgi pattern is characteristic of CD30. In the context of the H&E morphology, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, and ALK immunostaining is needed to classify ALK-positive versus ALK-negative disease.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are also CD30+ with Golgi staining but are scattered singly in a mixed inflammatory background, usually CD15+ and PAX5 weak+, and ALK-negative.
DLBCL expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5), and CD30 is usually heterogeneous rather than strong and uniform.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows variable, weaker CD30 in a subset of cells rather than strong uniform staining in all large cells.

ddx.dx: Embryonal carcinoma or CD30+ metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: Carcinomas are cytokeratin-positive and negative for CD45 and T-cell markers.

3158.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見各階段的顆粒球系細胞（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、帶狀與分葉嗜中性球）與深染小圓核的紅血球系前驅細胞混雜，比例與成熟順序正常，沒有母細胞增多，符合正常骨髓。
features: Mixed population of granulocytic precursors at all stages: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with small round dense nuclei and a rim of polychromatophilic cytoplasm
Granulocytic cells outnumber erythroid cells, consistent with a normal M:E ratio
Scattered lymphocytes; no increase in blasts
Occasional macrophage with blue-green cytoplasmic material in the lower left
Background of red cells from peripheral blood admixture
3158.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a heterogeneous population of hematopoietic cells with orderly granulocytic maturation from promyelocytes and myelocytes through bands and segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei are present in appropriate proportion, and scattered lymphocytes and an occasional macrophage are noted. Blasts are not increased and no dysplastic features are evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a normal bone marrow aspirate with trilineage maturation (megakaryocytes are not assessable in this field).

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows an increased M:E ratio with left-shifted maturation and toxic changes, which are not prominent here.
CML shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks, basophilia and eosinophilia, and BCR::ABL1.
MDS shows dysplasia such as hypogranular or hypolobated neutrophils and megaloblastoid erythroid precursors, which are not evident in this field.

2966.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片沿骨小樑旁排列著多層核大、染色質細緻、細胞質淡粉紅的早期顆粒球前驅細胞，其上方散布許多含亮紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球，而成熟分葉嗜中性球很少。
features: Paratrabecular layers of early myeloid precursors with oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and pale pink cytoplasm
Numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes with bright red granules
Paucity of mature segmented neutrophils
Admixed erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Unremarkable bony trabecula with lining cells
2966.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows several paratrabecular layers of early granulocytic precursors with oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and pale granular cytoplasm. Toward the intertrabecular space there are numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors, along with erythroid precursors, whereas mature segmented neutrophils are sparse. Findings are consistent with a left-shifted granulopoiesis with maturation arrest and relative eosinophilia, as seen in severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome).

ddx.vs: AML shows diffuse sheets of blasts displacing hematopoiesis with CD34 positivity, rather than normal paratrabecular early precursors.
Normal marrow shows maturation away from trabeculae to abundant bands and segmented neutrophils.
Reactive eosinophilia occurs with normal neutrophil maturation and elevated peripheral eosinophil counts.

2838.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的漿細胞：核偏心、藍色豐富細胞質與核旁淡染區（hof），並可見雙核及較大核的不成熟漿細胞，提示多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, including clusters
Eccentric round nuclei with clock-face to coarsely clumped chromatin
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate and larger immature-appearing plasma cells with higher N:C ratio
Background erythrocytes with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered small mature lymphoid/erythroid nuclei
2838.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells, some in small clusters. Many are atypical, with binucleation, enlarged nuclei and variation in size, while retaining eccentric nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing. Red cells in the background show a tendency to stack. A precise plasma cell percentage cannot be derived from this single field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with multiple myeloma in the proper clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually under 10% of marrow cells, lack binucleation clusters and are polytypic for kappa/lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in cohesive groups and have a pale hof located away from the nucleus rather than directly adjacent to it.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are large immunoblast-like cells with prominent central nucleoli, often EBER-positive and typically extramedullary.

2582.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆與紅血球大小相近的圓形細胞，整個細胞被粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒覆蓋並遮住細胞核，典型的嗜鹼性球（basophil）。
features: Round cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Numerous coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus, so lobation is not clearly seen
Scant visible cytoplasm between granules
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets in the background
2582.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single round leukocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells, filled with coarse, dark purple-black metachromatic granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus. The morphology is that of a mature basophil. Red cells and platelets in the field are unremarkable. An isolated basophil is a normal finding; absolute basophilia should prompt evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and densely packed smaller granules, occur mainly in marrow or tissue, and are rarely seen in blood.
Eosinophils have larger, refractile orange-red granules that do not obscure the bilobed nucleus.
Toxic neutrophils show fine dark granules over pale cytoplasm with a clearly visible segmented nucleus, not coarse granules obscuring the nucleus.
Precipitate lies in a different focal plane and also over red cells and background, whereas basophil granules are confined to the cell.

2518.recognize_zh: 成群的漿細胞，核偏位、染色質粗、胞質豐富灰藍並有核旁淡染區，大小略有差異，背景紅血球呈疊錢狀（rouleaux），符合漿細胞腫瘤／漿細胞白血病。
features: Cluster of numerous plasma cells with mild variation in size
Round eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin; some larger nuclei with more open chromatin
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof and irregular cytoplasmic borders
Occasional smaller mature-appearing lymphoid or plasma cells
Background red cells showing rouleaux formation
2518.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs; several cells are larger with more open chromatin, indicating mild pleomorphism. Red cells in the background show rouleaux formation. Whether this is a peripheral blood or aspirate preparation cannot be determined from this field alone. Findings are consistent with a clonal plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia if from peripheral blood; flow cytometry with light chain restriction is recommended.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma in bone marrow
ddx.vs: Myeloma involves the marrow, and plasma cell leukemia requires demonstration of at least 5% circulating plasma cells in peripheral blood.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger with prominent central nucleoli and high proliferation, often EBER positive and in HIV-positive patients.
Reactive plasmacytosis is polytypic by kappa/lambda testing and lacks prominent rouleaux from a monoclonal protein.

2198.recognize_zh: 油鏡下只見一顆約紅血球大小的細胞，核分葉不規則、染色質團塊狀，細胞質含細小紫紅顆粒並有一小黑點；看不到弓形蟲速殖體的新月形構造，本圖無法由形態支持題目診斷。
features: Single small leukocyte roughly the size of adjacent RBCs
Irregular lobulated nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine pinkish-purple granules
One small dark punctate inclusion at the cell periphery
No crescent-shaped tachyzoites identifiable; background RBCs with rouleaux-like clumping
2198.describe_en: Smear at oil immersion shows a single small leukocyte, approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, with an irregular lobulated nucleus, coarse clumped chromatin, and cytoplasm containing fine pinkish-purple granules and a small dark punctate inclusion. The appearance is most in keeping with a granulocyte. No crescent-shaped tachyzoites with discrete nuclei are identified, so the image does not itself demonstrate Toxoplasma organisms. The diagnosis of toxoplasmosis must rest on serology, PCR or tissue immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: A neutrophil has a segmented nucleus and fine cytoplasmic granules with no intracellular crescentic organisms, which fits this cell.
Leishmania amastigotes are multiple oval bodies each with a nucleus and kinetoplast, not a single tiny dark dot.
An overlying platelet shows a pale hyalomere around a granular center and lies in a different focal plane rather than inside the cytoplasm.

2070.recognize_zh: 細胞學抹片中可見許多中大型異常淋巴樣細胞，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、部分有核仁、細胞質藍色，並混有大量嗜中性球；但本圖保存不佳，看不到 Burkitt 典型的深藍細胞質與脂質空泡，僅部分符合。
features: Numerous medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular or folded nuclei and fine chromatin
Some cells with small nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Characteristic cytoplasmic lipid vacuoles are not convincingly seen in this field
Abundant admixed segmented neutrophils and occasional small lymphocytes
Suboptimal preservation with smudged nuclear detail and a proteinaceous background
2070.describe_en: Cytologic preparation shows a population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with numerous neutrophils. The classic deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles is not convincingly demonstrated, and cell preservation is suboptimal. The atypical cells are compatible with a high-grade lymphoma, but the morphology in this field is not specific for Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation requires immunophenotyping (CD10+, BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100%) and MYC rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are more pleomorphic and larger with variable Ki-67 and BCL2 expression, requiring immunophenotype and MYC/BCL2 FISH to separate from Burkitt.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: It can mimic Burkitt morphology but shows BCL2 protein and rearrangement on FISH.
Blasts are TdT or CD34 positive (lymphoblastic) or MPO positive (myeloid), whereas Burkitt cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface immunoglobulin.

1814.recognize_zh: 整片骨髓被漿細胞取代：核偏位、細胞質豐富且呈深藍色，核旁可見淡染的核周亮區（perinuclear hof），部分細胞較大、染色質較細且有雙核，提示腫瘤性漿細胞（多發性骨髓瘤）。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal marrow elements
Eccentric round nuclei with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs
Clumped to more open chromatin; some immature forms with finer chromatin and larger size
Occasional binucleate plasma cells
Cytoplasmic streaming/tails; background with erythrocytes
1814.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of plasma cells that replace normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, with a spectrum from mature forms with clumped chromatin to larger immature forms with finer chromatin. Binucleate forms are present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma); quantitation, light chain restriction by flow or IHC/ISH, and CRAB/SLiM criteria are needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are usually under 10%, mature, polytypic for kappa/lambda and scattered around vessels rather than in sheets.
Shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Cells are larger immunoblastic/plasmablastic with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67, frequent EBER positivity and typically no bone lytic/CRAB profile.
Clonal plasma cells are below 10% without myeloma-defining events, unlike the sheets seen here.

1622.recognize_zh: 高倍下大部分視野為混合的中心母細胞與有切跡的中心細胞，夾雜吞噬凋亡碎片的巨噬細胞與核分裂，右上角為密集深染的小淋巴球外套區，是正常生發中心與外套區交界的表現。
features: Mixture of large centroblasts with vesicular nuclei and peripheral nucleoli and smaller cleaved centrocytes
Tingible body macrophages with pale cytoplasm and phagocytosed apoptotic debris
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Dense small round lymphocytes of the mantle zone at the upper right
Pale eosinophilic intercellular cytoplasm of dendritic cells
1622.describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a germinal center composed of a heterogeneous mixture of centroblasts and centrocytes, with scattered tingible body macrophages, mitoses and apoptotic bodies. The upper right corner shows the adjacent mantle zone of densely packed small lymphocytes. The cellular heterogeneity and phagocytic activity indicate a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a normal reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: FL follicles are monotonous, centrocyte-predominant, with few tingible body macrophages and low mitotic activity for grade 1-2, and are BCL2 positive.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a starry-sky pattern but with monotonous medium-sized cells, near 100% Ki-67 and MYC rearrangement rather than mixed centroblasts and centrocytes.
DLBCL forms diffuse sheets of large atypical cells without a mantle zone, whereas this center is bordered by a normal mantle.

1430.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞密度高，箭頭指出的巨核細胞體積小、只有單一圓形或低分葉的核，屬於異常增生的小型／低分葉巨核細胞（micromegakaryocytes / hypolobated megakaryocytes），背景有紅系與顆粒球前驅細胞，是 MDS 巨核細胞異型性的線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage precursors between fat spaces
Arrowed small megakaryocytes with a single round or hypolobated nucleus and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors and occasional larger immature cells with nucleoli
No obvious clusters of blasts at this magnification
1430.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. The arrows highlight small megakaryocytes with single round or hypolobated nuclei and modest eosinophilic cytoplasm, consistent with dysplastic micromegakaryocytes. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are abundant, with occasional larger immature cells but no obvious blast clusters at this power. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm; confirmation of multilineage dysplasia on the aspirate, blast enumeration (CD34 staining) and cytogenetics are recommended.

ddx.vs: del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal-sized to small with round monolobated nuclei, and distinction requires karyotype.
CML dwarf megakaryocytes occur with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but retain normal size and lobation.

60310.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球在中央淡染區內又出現一個血紅素染色的中心點，形成「靶心」外觀（target cells / codocytes），旁邊有小淋巴球可對照大小，符合靶形紅血球。
features: Numerous target cells with a central hemoglobinized dot surrounded by a pale ring and peripheral rim of hemoglobin
Red cells roughly normocytic compared with the small lymphocyte nucleus
Occasional stomatocyte-like and folded cells
Fine dark dot-like inclusions in some red cells (possible Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies; not definitively resolvable at this magnification)
Scattered platelets and a single small lymphocyte
60310.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells (codocytes) with a central condensation of hemoglobin within the zone of pallor, among otherwise roughly normocytic red cells. Occasional folded and stomatocyte-like cells are present, and some red cells contain tiny dark dots whose nature cannot be confirmed at this magnification. A small lymphocyte and scattered platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with target cells, which are seen in liver disease, hemoglobinopathies (HbC, HbE, thalassemia), post-splenectomy states and as a drying artifact.

ddx.vs: Artifactual targets are confined to thick or slowly dried areas and appear uniformly, whereas true target cells are distributed in well-spread areas among normal discocytes.
Stomatocytes have a slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor without a central dense hemoglobin spot.
HbC disease shows target cells together with dense microspherocytes and intraerythrocytic rhomboid crystals, requiring hemoglobin electrophoresis for confirmation.
Thalassemia target cells are accompanied by marked microcytosis, hypochromia and basophilic stippling, which are not prominent here.

86.recognize_zh: 胃／腸黏膜固有層被中型、胞質淡嗜酸性的非典型淋巴樣細胞瀰漫擴張，但腺體大致保留、無明顯破壞或壞死；免疫染色中這些細胞呈強陽性、而旁邊的 T 細胞標記僅散在少數細胞陽性，符合表淺、非破壞性的 NK 細胞增生（NK-cell enteropathy）。
features: Lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense, superficial infiltrate that separates but largely spares the glands
Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
No destructive lymphoepithelial lesions, angiocentric destruction or geographic necrosis; focal lamina propria hemorrhage
Infiltrate strongly and diffusely positive for a membranous/cytoplasmic marker (images consistent with NK-associated markers such as CD56/cytoplasmic CD3; labels not provided)
Another marker (likely a T-cell marker such as CD5/CD8; label not provided) stains only scattered small lymphocytes, leaving the atypical cells negative
Second biopsy shows the same lamina propria expansion with preserved crypts on H&E and diffuse positivity on IHC
86.describe_en: Endoscopic gastrointestinal mucosal biopsies show marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense, predominantly superficial infiltrate that separates and surrounds intact glands without significant gland destruction, ulcer-bed necrosis or angiodestruction. At high power the infiltrate consists of medium-sized lymphoid cells with mildly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Immunohistochemical stains (markers not labeled on the images) show the atypical cells to be diffusely positive for a membranous/cytoplasmic marker in both biopsies, while a separate marker highlights only scattered small reactive lymphocytes and is negative in the atypical population. In the appropriate context (CD3ε+, CD56+, cytotoxic granule+, CD5-, EBER-negative, no clonal TCR rearrangement), findings are consistent with NK-cell enteropathy (lymphomatoid gastropathy).

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows angiocentric, angiodestructive growth with extensive necrosis and is EBER-positive, whereas NK-cell enteropathy is superficial, non-destructive and EBER-negative.

ddx.dx: Enteropathy-associated / monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show transmural destructive infiltrates, prominent epitheliotropism and clonal TCR rearrangement (MEITL CD8+/CD56+), unlike the mucosa-confined, non-clonal NK proliferation here.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: It is composed of small, mature-appearing clonal CD3+ T cells (usually CD8+ or CD4+, surface CD5 often retained) rather than medium-sized CD56+ NK cells with cytoplasmic CD3ε and polyclonal TCR.

ddx.dx: Reactive chronic gastritis/duodenitis with dense lamina propria inflammation
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are mixed (plasma cells, eosinophils, small lymphocytes) without a monotonous sheet of medium-sized atypical cells uniformly expressing NK markers.

captions: Low power H&E: mucosal biopsy with lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense infiltrate
Medium power H&E: sheets of lymphoid cells separating intact glands
High power H&E: medium-sized atypical cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, no gland destruction
IHC: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic staining of the lamina propria infiltrate, glands negative
IHC: diffuse positivity of the infiltrate around negative glands
IHC (likely T-cell marker): only scattered small lymphocytes positive; atypical cells negative
Low power IHC (low resolution): strong staining concentrated in one fragment
IHC: strong diffuse membranous staining of the infiltrate
Second biopsy H&E: lamina propria expansion with preserved crypts and hemorrhage
Second biopsy IHC: diffuse positivity of lamina propria cells between negative crypts

22.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被成片的中型芽細胞取代，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、胞質少；切片中芽細胞瀰漫浸潤且 CD3 大片陽性，流式顯示 CD45 弱陽性芽細胞 77% 表現胞質與表面 CD3、CD5、CD7，缺 CD19，指向 T 淋巴芽細胞白血病；但此例 TdT 與 CD34 皆陰性，屬少見表型。
features: Aspirate: sheets of intermediate to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and indistinct to small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm; residual normal elements (occasional eosinophil) are sparse
PB: scattered circulating blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Biopsy: diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous intermediate-sized cells between fat cells, labeled hypocellular for age
IHC: CD3 diffusely positive in the infiltrate; TdT stains only rare scattered nuclei; CD34 negative
Flow: 77% blasts, CD45 dim-moderate, CD3+ (cytoplasmic and surface), CD5+, CD7+, partial CD2+, CD4-, CD8-, CD19-, CD10-, CD34-
22.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows scattered blasts with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm on a background of largely unremarkable red cells. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. The core biopsy, described as hypocellular for age, shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous immature cells that is diffusely CD3 positive and CD34 negative, with TdT staining only rare cells. Flow cytometry identifies 77% abnormal T-lineage blasts expressing cytoplasmic and surface CD3, CD5, CD7 and HLA-DR, with partial CD2, and lacking CD4, CD8, CD19, CD10 and CD34; TdT is reported negative, which is unusual and warrants additional immaturity markers such as CD1a or CD99. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Blasts look identical on smear, but B-ALL expresses CD19, CD22 and usually CD10 and lacks cytoplasmic CD3, the opposite of this CD3+CD7+CD19- profile.
